name: Peekalo
googleShortDescription: Capture a moment. Share with chosen people. Hold to reveal.
description:
Start with your camera. Take a photo or hold to record a video up to ten seconds, then review, retake or share.

Send a moment to chosen Peekalo accounts, or create a single-use web link. Received moments stay hidden until you hold to reveal. Each authorized account or claiming browser gets up to ten seconds total per moment across holds. Loading and interrupted holds can use part of that allowance.

Keep up to three active moments. Delete one to make room. Manage recipients and revoke links for future access.

Continue the conversation with text chat and comments. New conversations require acceptance. Report content or accounts, block identified accounts, and request account deletion from your profile. Shared content is subject to moderation.

An external link needs no viewer sign-in. The first deliberate reveal claims it for that browser; forwarded unclaimed links can be claimed by someone else. Losing the claiming browser cookie loses access to its remaining time. Blocking an account cannot identify a separate anonymous browser.

Share thoughtfully. Browser viewers can save or capture revealed content. Native capture protections vary by device. Viewing limits, revocation and deletion cannot recall bytes someone already received. Peekalo is not end-to-end encrypted.

Photos and videos come from the in-app camera. Peekalo does not import your gallery or phone address book.
